<div class="card-body">
'''Fusion Generator Supply Tanks''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">融合ジェネレーター供給タンク</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">対応するドッキング・ベイの位置カードが場に出ている星系カードの宇宙船に配備する。航行速度＋１、戦闘力＋１、回避値＋１となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-203o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">宇宙艦船にパワーを供給するため、帝国内の多くの補給基地に設置されている。亜光速航行やハイパースペース航行に不可欠なエネルギーを供給する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Fusion Generator Supply Tanks.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on a starship at a system whose corresponding docking bay site is on table. The starship is hyperspeed, power, and maneuver +1.

'''Lore:''' Installed at many Imperial supply bases to power starships. They supply energy essential for sublight and hyperspace travel.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses corresponding docking bay; the English uses related docking bay.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks (Dark)|Fusion Generator Supply Tanks]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
